teaser: A showcase repository that runs four ways of moving a vault between GitHub Actions jobs side by side, measured, with a budget for its LLM steps.
core_idea: A dedicated repository and site should run sgit in GitHub Actions for real on every release, moving the same build through four lanes in parallel, a vault server with keys in secrets, the encrypted vault as an immutable artefact, the vault as published files cloned read-only, and append lanes for shards, reporting time, bytes, keys and a screenshot per lane on growing vaults; measured locally, a one-folder clone barely grows with the vault while a full clone does, the runs surfaced defects worth tracking as issues, and every model call is counted against a per-run token budget across providers.
